data.one_liner: Generates and sets up Widgetbook code via build_runner
data.what_it_does: It automates the creation of Widgetbook configuration files and components. The generator runs as a build_runner builder and outputs Dart code that integrates with the widgetbook package.
use_when: You want to use Widgetbook for isolated widget testing and documentation.
You need to keep Widgetbook configuration in sync with your codebase.
avoid_when: You are not using Widgetbook or prefer manual setup.
data.setup_notes: Add widgetbook_generator to dev_dependencies, run `flutter pub run build_runner build` to generate code.
